import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Code254Proof
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Code254ProofAudit
open Code254 Code254Proof
#print axioms RawProof.sound
#print axioms rawProof_exists
#print axioms decode_node
#print axioms RawProof.height_le_quote
#print axioms RawProof.decode_quote
#print axioms check_sound
#print axioms RawProof.check_quote
#print axioms c254_iff_checked
#print axioms reject_zero
#print axioms accept_truth

example (n : Nat) : C254 n ↔ ∃ code, check code n = true := c254_iff_checked n
example (p : RawProof) : decodeFuel (p.quote + 1) p.quote = some p :=
  p.decode_quote _ (Nat.le_trans p.height_le_quote (Nat.le_succ _))
example (a b c u : Nat) : check (RawProof.r8 a b c u).quote (rho8 a b c u) = true :=
  (RawProof.r8 a b c u).check_quote
example (a b c : Nat) (hca : c ≠ a) (hcb : c ≠ b) :
    check (RawProof.bundle a b c).quote (Code254.bundle a b c) = true := by
  simpa [RawProof.conclusion, RawProof.valid, hca, hcb] using (RawProof.bundle a b c).check_quote
example {n : Nat} (code : Nat) (h : check code n = true) : C254 n := check_sound h
example : check 1 1 = false := by decide
example : check 170 0 = true := by decide
example : check 51 6 = true := by decide
example : check 12 0 = false := by decide
example : check 24 0 = false := by decide
example : check 13 0 = false := by decide
example : check (node 1 (P 0 (P 1 0))) 0 = false := by decide
example : check (node 1 (P 1 (P 1 1))) 1 = false := by decide
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Code254ProofAudit
